title: 명사 만들기: 웃음, 느낌, 크기
objective: By the end, you can understand ten nouns made with -음, -ㅁ and -기, such as 믿음, 느낌 and 크기, and use them in short everyday sentences.
summary: Learn ten everyday Korean nouns made from verbs and adjectives with -음, -ㅁ and -기, and use them in short sentences.

task.title: Use the new nouns
task.line: Make the nouns, then choose or write the word from this worksheet that fits each sentence.

words.exampleMeaning: Trust is the most important thing between friends.

words.example: 이별의 아픔은 시간이 지나면 조금씩 줄어들어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The pain of a breakup slowly fades as time passes.
After lunch, I get really sleepy.
When I see the baby, I can't help smiling.

words.example: 할머니는 걸음이 느리셔서 천천히 같이 걸었어요.
words.exampleMeaning: My grandmother walks slowly, so I walked slowly with her.

words.example: 어제 동생하고 사소한 일로 싸움이 났어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Yesterday my sibling and I got into an argument over something small.

words.example: 한국에 와서 제 삶이 많이 바뀌었어요.
words.exampleMeaning: My life changed a lot after I came to Korea.
I had a good feeling about them from the first time we met.

words.example: 이 가방은 노트북이 들어가는 크기라서 편해요.
words.exampleMeaning: This bag is handy because it's big enough for a laptop.
I go running in the park every morning.

exercises: Change each word into the noun taught in this worksheet: ① 믿다 ② 웃다 ③ 크다 ④ 느끼다
Choose the right word: 수업 시간에 ____이 와서 커피를 마셨어요. (졸음 / 걸음)
Fill in the blank with a word from this worksheet: 그 부부는 결혼하고 10년 동안 한 번도 ____을 안 했대요.
Choose the right word for each blank: ① 운동회에서 동생이 ____ 1등을 했어요. (달리기 / 삶) ② 할아버지는 시골에서 조용한 ____을 사세요. (삶 / 아픔)
Fill in each blank with a word from this worksheet: ① 다리를 다쳐서 ____이 느려졌어요. ② 마음의 ____은 쉽게 낫지 않아요.
answers: ① 믿음 ② 웃음 ③ 크기 ④ 느낌
